questions.question: What makes a fresh loader resume at the saved next batch?
options: Restoring compatible iterator state after rebuilding its source/sampler configuration.
Calling next once regardless of checkpoint position.
questions.explanation: Seed and source determine order, but iterator state determines where the resumed reader begins.
optionFeedback: A seed restarts an initial sequence; it does not specify the current cursor. Rebuild the compatible pipeline and restore its iterator state.
Seed and source determine order, but iterator state determines where the resumed reader begins.
Consuming one batch moves the cursor and can skip data. Verify the restored next batch against the uninterrupted run before advancing.
